item.title: Former DOJ attorneys oppose Trump’s Illinois voter data lawsuit
item.description: Eighteen former DOJ attorneys filed a brief opposing the Trump administration’s lawsuit seeking Illinois voter registration data, citing legal and privacy concerns.

item.title: U.S. Justice Department aims to limit state ethics probes into its lawyers
item.description: The U.S. Justice Department proposes a rule allowing the attorney general to review and potentially delay state ethics investigations into current or former DOJ lawyers.

item.title: Minnesota lawyers tell U.N. of ICE enforcement impacts
item.description: Minnesota attorneys told the U.N. Human Rights Council that intensified ICE immigration enforcement is harming immigrant communities, courts, and civil liberties.

item.title: Minnesota joins lawsuit to stop Trump’s latest global tariffs
item.description: Minnesota and 23 other states sued to stop President Trump’s newly imposed 10% global tariffs, alleging they are illegal under recent Supreme Court rulings.

item.title: $17M wrongful death verdict reached in insanity case
item.description: Minnesota jury awards $17M wrongful death verdict to family of woman killed by boyfriend found not guilty by reason of insanity in criminal case.

item.title: Erin Secord joins Dorsey & Whitney
item.description: Attorney Erin Secord has joined Dorsey & Whitney LLP as of counsel in the firm’s Healthcare Litigation Group in Minneapolis.
